city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom in Fullerton, CA: birth support and doula care
city_fields.culture: Fullerton is a north Orange County city of roughly 139,000 residents at the county's northern edge, known for its historic water tower, the Fullerton College and CSUF campus districts, and a downtown built around the 100-year-old train station. Birth support here spans hospital-based care at Providence St. Jude Medical Center and the nearby Level III NICU hospitals in Whittier and Anaheim, alongside the county's out-of-hospital community: Birth Your Way Doulas, a DONA-certified practice that publishes its package prices and takes Medi-Cal and Kaiser in-network, and Maternal Root, a Fullerton-based birth doula practice. California's Medi-Cal doula benefit, in effect since January 2023, has expanded access for Fullerton families on Medi-Cal, and Francesca Herrera of Maternal Root reports attending 90 births over 7 years.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Yes — California's Medi-Cal program has covered full-spectrum doula services as a preventive benefit since January 1, 2023, including prenatal and postpartum visits, labor and delivery support, and support for miscarriage, stillbirth, and abortion. Enrolled doulas bill Medi-Cal through the Department of Health Care Services. Birth Your Way Doulas is in-network for Medi-Cal, and Becky Chavez offers zero out-of-pocket coverage for HMO in-network Kaiser, Health Net, private, and Medi-Cal clients.
